family: Block C: Risk, Diligence and Decision

prompts.authority_limits: Records coverage and findings; cannot fabricate specialist conclusions.
evidence_rules: Each finding links to workstream evidence
counterevidence_rules: Keep adverse findings separate from rebuttals
prompts.invention_prohibition: Do not mark unperformed diligence complete.

prompts.authority_limits: Identifies risk and questions; cannot give legal advice or clearance.
evidence_rules: Use current authoritative law/guidance and dated counsel evidence
counterevidence_rules: Record adverse precedents and theories of harm
prompts.invention_prohibition: Do not invent jurisdiction, approval or legal conclusion.

prompts.authority_limits: Assesses execution risks; cannot promise retention or delivery.
evidence_rules: Risks trace to value drivers and operating dependencies
counterevidence_rules: Record talent flight, customer attrition and systems complexity
prompts.invention_prohibition: Do not assume retention or integration timing.
prompts.role_boundary: Does not authorize the integration plan.

prompts.authority_limits: Stress-tests evidence and registered scenarios; cannot offset risk with unverified upside.
evidence_rules: Drivers sourced and calculations replayed where quantifiable
prompts.invention_prohibition: Do not invent probabilities or mitigations.
prompts.role_boundary: Stress-tests; does not issue final approval.

prompts.authority_limits: May emit supported machine state; cannot make final human Go / No-Go approval.
output_contract: PROCEED, PROCEED_WITH_CONDITIONS, RENEGOTIATE, PAUSE, NO_GO or HUMAN_REVIEW
evidence_rules: Every rationale links to gate criteria and verified records
counterevidence_rules: Failed criteria and adverse evidence remain visible
prompts.invention_prohibition: Do not invent approval, resolution or reviewer sign-off.
prompts.role_boundary: Feeds Gate C and remains decision support, not final approval.
